selection_policy: Official documentation and repositories for frameworks already material to the Aurora design discussion.

sources.title: Mastra Documentation
supports: TypeScript agents, tools, workflows, memory, observability and evals
limitations: Framework features do not constitute Aurora domain/security/durability

sources.title: Introducing Temporal Workflows in Mastra
supports: Temporal integration for longer durable workflows
separation of framework and durable engine

sources.title: LangGraph Overview and Persistence
limitations: Framework graph state is not Aurora global state
External effect semantics remain application responsibility

sources.title: Pi Mono Repository
supports: minimal coding agent, model API, extensions and SDK
limitations: Repository details must be revalidated before integration

sources.title: Pi RPC Documentation
limitations: Does not define Aurora contracts or authority

sources.title: OpenHands SDK Architecture
supports: software-agent architecture, conversations, tools, workspaces and events
limitations: Not personal memory or laboratory architecture

sources.title: OpenAI Agents SDK
supports: agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing
limitations: Guardrails do not replace effect enforcement
Provider/framework semantics are not Aurora domain

sources.title: Langflow Documentation
limitations: Visual prototype/runtime is not current Aurora Core hypothesis
